zh.title: 美國擬對巴西製完整飛機加徵10%關稅
zh.summary: 美國貿易代表署就巴西製完整飛機加徵10%關稅的提案徵詢意見。
body: 美國貿易代表署11月25日公告，擬依《1974年貿易法》第301條，對自巴西進口的完整飛機額外加徵10%從價關稅。提案適用範圍以公告所列稅則為準。
貿易代表署將這項構想納入對巴西貿易措施的調整方案，並開放外界提交意見。飛機關稅目前仍在提案階段。

en.title: U.S. proposes additional 10% tariff on finished aircraft from Brazil
en.summary: The U.S. Trade Representative is seeking public comment on a proposed additional 10% duty on finished aircraft imports from Brazil.
body: The U.S. Trade Representative announced on November 25 that it is proposing an additional 10% ad valorem duty under Section 301 on finished aircraft imported from Brazil. The notice sets out the tariff classifications that would be covered.
The agency opened the proposal to public comment as part of a broader revision of trade measures relating to Brazil. The aircraft duty has been proposed and has yet to take effect.

facts.claim: The U.S. Trade Representative is seeking public comment on a proposed additional 10% duty on finished aircraft imports from Brazil.
